settings.hero_title: Crafted with Love, Worn with Pride.
settings.hero_text: At Srivaya, we believe every woman deserves to shine — every single day.
settings.story_body:
It all started with a simple question — why should stunning jewellery always come with a stunning price tag? Srivaya was born in the heart of India, founded by people who deeply believe that every woman — regardless of her budget — deserves to feel beautiful, confident, and celebrated.

We saw a gap in the market where quality AD Jewellery was either too expensive or too hard to find online. So we decided to change that. What began as a small passion project has grown into a brand trusted by thousands of happy customers across India.

Every piece we curate is handpicked with love, care, and an eye for detail — because jewellery isn't just an accessory, it's an emotion.
settings.ad_intro: AD stands for American Diamond — a premium quality cubic zirconia stone that mirrors the brilliance and sparkle of a real diamond, at a fraction of the cost.
settings.why_1_text: Every piece is carefully quality-checked before it reaches you.
settings.why_2_text: We deliver to every corner of India, quickly and safely.
settings.why_3_text: Your order arrives beautifully packaged, gift-ready.
settings.why_4_text: Hassle-free return & exchange policy — no questions asked.
settings.why_5_text: Designer looks without the designer price tag.
settings.mission_quote: To make every woman feel like the most elegant version of herself — through jewellery that is beautiful, accessible, and made for real life.
settings.mission_body: We don't just sell jewellery. We help you create memories — at your best friend's wedding, your first office party, your daughter's first birthday, or just a regular Tuesday when you want to feel a little extra special.
settings.founder_quote: When I started Srivaya, I wanted every customer to feel the same excitement I feel when I discover a truly stunning piece of jewellery. I wanted it to be affordable enough that you don't think twice, and beautiful enough that you never forget it. Every design on this website has been personally curated with that feeling in mind. Thank you for being a part of our journey — you are the reason Srivaya exists.
settings.social_text: We love seeing you shine. Tag us in your photos and be part of the Srivaya family.
